subject: Proposed capacity collar and prorated credits for Q3 renewal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Paula Gomez <paula@spectra.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed capacity collar and prorated credits for Q3 renewal

Hi Paula —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As Spectra’s usage continues to scale into Q3, I put together a short proposal to keep unit economics predictable for you while giving us headroom for the burst you mentioned (data ingestion spike around product launch). Key points in the attached draft:

- Capacity collar: a committed baseline of 250M tokens/month with a ceiling of 550M tokens for burst months; overages above ceiling billed at list with a prorated credit applied (see schedule).
- Prorated credits: monthly true-up credits tied to actual usage vs commit (tiered discounts for growth months); credits apply as offsets on next invoice — not retroactive refunds.
- Price hold: 6-month price hold on baseline unit rates if Spectra increases baseline commit by >=20% in the signed amendment.
- Trial: 3-month dedicated pool for latency-sensitive endpoints at a reduced rate (internal approval attached).

I attached a one-page renewal draft (Spectra_Renewal_Draft.pdf) and a sample prorate table (spectra_prorate_schedule.csv). If this looks directionally right, can we schedule a 30-minute call this week with Ricardo (procurement) to align on legal and PO timing?

Next steps I recommend:
1) You + procurement confirm desired baseline commit (we assume 250M by default).
2) We lock pricing hold and collar in an amendment, legal to review.
3) Sign by May 5 to hit the July 1 renewal effective date and secure current list rates for 6 months.

Open to tweaks — primarily flags for me are length of price hold and exact thresholds for the prorated credits.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Spectra_Renewal_Draft.pdf (proposal), spectra_prorate_schedule.csv (sample schedule)

From: Paula Gomez <paula@spectra.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ricardo Alvarez <ricardo.procure@spectra.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed capacity collar and prorated credits for Q3 renewal

Karthik —

Thanks for the proposal and the clear bullets. High level this seems reasonable. A couple quick asks from procurement before we chat:

- Can you show how the prorated credits flow for a month where actual = 410M tokens (i.e., between baseline and ceiling)? We need to show CFO the cash-flow impact.
- Will the 6-month price hold also apply to embedding units, or only generation tokens?
- Is the dedicated pool trial cost fixed or consumption-based?

Looping in Ricardo (procurement) to pick a time. Ricardo — are mornings next Thursday/Friday ok for a 30?

Best,
Paula
Head of Product, Spectra AI
paula@spectra.ai | +1 212-555-3344

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Paula Gomez <paula@spectra.ai>, Ricardo Alvarez <ricardo.procure@spectra.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed capacity collar and prorated credits for Q3 renewal

Paula / Ricardo —

Quick answers inline and a worked example below. Attached is an updated prorate CSV that includes the 410M example.

- Prorated credits flow: For usage between baseline (250M) and ceiling (550M) we apply a tiered credit % that increases with usage. Example month: actual = 410M 
  - Baseline (250M) billed at baseline unit rate = $0.0009/token = $225,000
  - Growth band (250M -> 410M = 160M) billed at baseline rate but you receive a prorated credit: first 100M of growth = 6% credit, next 60M = 9% credit. Net billing on growth band = (160M * $0.0009) * (1 - weighted credit ~7.125%) ≈ $133,680
  - Total month charge ≈ $358,680 before any seat/add-ons
  - Credit applied to next invoice as a line item: "Prorated growth credit — Apr 2027: $10,900" (illustrative numbers in attached CSV).

- Price hold: Applies to generation tokens and embeddings used for model serving (we will carve out experimental playground usage). We can make this explicit in the amendment.

- Dedicated pool trial: fixed monthly fee for 3 months (covers reserved GPUs); overage on top is consumption-based if exceeded.

Proposed concession ask for internal approval:
- Anchor discount: 15% off baseline unit rates if Spectra signs for a 25% increase to baseline (to 312.5M).
- Price hold: 6 months after the effective date.
- No ad-hoc credits beyond the scheduled prorates and the trial concession.

Paula — can you confirm whether the CFO wants the credits as invoice offsets (we proposed that) or as a cash rebate? Most enterprise finance teams prefer offsets to simplify forecasting.

If procurement is OK, I'll ask Ben and Lauren for final sign-off on the anchor discount and we can get legal to spin an amendment.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed capacity collar and prorated credits for Q3 renewal

Thanks for the summary, Karthik — reviewed the numbers. Approve the concession with a few limits:

1) Anchor discount: approve 12% off baseline if Spectra ups baseline by >=20% (not 25%).
2) Price hold: 6 months as proposed.
3) Prorated credits: OK as invoice offsets only (no cash rebates). Credits capped at 18% effective across the growth band.
4) Dedicated pool trial: allowed for 3 months; any capacity beyond reserved must be pre-approved by CS.

Legal should draft an amendment with these constraints; no further discounts without SVP approval. Target to have amendment signed by May 5 to keep July 1 start. Karthik — move this to legal and loop in account exec resources for the amendment signature push.

Ben Carter
Revenue Manager, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
